Ekaterina Smirnova  
Tel Aviv, Israel | +972-52-345-6789 | ekaterina.smirnova@example.com | linkedin.com/in/ekaterina-smirnova | github.com/ekaterina-smirnova  

A software developer with a focus on healthtech, leveraging full-stack expertise to build scalable, secure applications that integrate with medical devices and patient data systems. Specialized in React, Node.js, and PostgreSQL, with a growing interest in cloud infrastructure and performance optimization. Currently contributing to HealthInsight Solutions as a full-stack developer, balancing backend architecture with frontend user experiences.  

**Projects**  
*Patient Monitoring Dashboard (MedTech Innovations, 2023)*  
Developed a real-time dashboard for tracking vital signs using React and Node.js, integrating with IoT-enabled medical devices. Implemented WebSocket connections for live data updates and designed a modular UI to support multiple device types. Collaborated with cross-functional teams to ensure compliance with HIPAA standards.  

*Medical Device Integration Platform (HealthInsight Solutions, 2023–2024)*  
Designed and deployed REST APIs to connect third-party medical equipment to the platform’s backend, enabling seamless data synchronization. Optimized PostgreSQL queries for patient records, reducing average response times by 30% through index restructuring and query caching. Introduced automated testing for API endpoints using Jest.  

**Professional Experience**  
*Junior Full-Stack Developer | HealthInsight Solutions (2023–present)*  
- Built a microservice architecture for device data processing, using Node.js and TypeScript to handle high-throughput sensor inputs.  
- Refactored legacy Python scripts for data preprocessing, improving reliability by 25% through error handling and modularization.  
- Partnered with DevOps engineers to implement CI/CD pipelines, reducing deployment cycles from 48 hours to 2 hours.  
- Contributed to a PostgreSQL-based analytics module, enhancing query performance via materialized views and connection pooling.  

*Software Developer Intern | MedTech Innovations (2022–2023)*  
- Assisted in prototyping a dashboard for remote patient monitoring, utilizing React components and Node.js backend services.  
- Supported the migration of a monolithic application to a containerized environment, using Docker to standardize development environments.  
- Conducted performance audits on frontend assets, reducing page load times by 15% through lazy loading and image optimization.  

**Education**  
Bachelor of Science in Computer Science | National Technical University of Ukraine (2018–2022)  

**Technical Skills**  
- **AWS**: Utilized S3 for storing anonymized patient data in compliance with GDPR.  
- **Docker**: Containerized backend services for consistent local and production environments.  
- **CI/CD pipelines**: Integrated GitHub Actions for automated testing and deployment of React components.  
- **GitHub Actions**: Streamlined release workflows for Node.js applications with automated linting and unit tests.  
- **Terraform**: Provisioned cloud resources for development environments, ensuring reproducibility across teams.  
- **Python**: Wrote scripts for data validation and preprocessing in medical device integration projects.  
- **REST API design**: Built scalable endpoints for device communication, prioritizing error handling and rate limiting.  
- **Node.js**: Developed core backend logic for real-time data processing and user authentication.  
- **React**: Created reusable components for dashboards, focusing on accessibility and responsive design.  
- **TypeScript**: Enhanced type safety in frontend code, reducing runtime errors by 20%.  
- **PostgreSQL**: Optimized database schemas for high-concurrency access in patient data systems.  
- **MongoDB**: Implemented document-based storage for unstructured medical notes, ensuring data integrity.  
- **Web performance optimization**: Reduced frontend bundle sizes by 40% through tree shaking and code splitting.  
- **Kubernetes**: Deployed containerized applications to managed clusters, improving scalability for peak loads.
